name: spen family transcriptional repressor
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: SPEN encodes msx2-interacting protein. Annotated molecular activities include transcription corepressor activity and RNA polymerase II-specific DNA-binding transcription factor binding. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Radio-Tartaglia syndrome (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia/Small Lymphocytic Lymphoma; Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma, NOS; Invasive Breast Carcinoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.
